# Hikvision Virtual Indoor Station

> A Home Assistant custom integration (domain `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station`) that makes Home Assistant the indoor station of a Hikvision video door station: the door's button rings in Home Assistant, the call is answered, talked through (push-to-talk) and hung up from dashboards and phones, and the doors open. Everything stays on the local network: SIP carries the call and its sound, RTSP the picture (and the sound while monitoring), ISAPI the doors. License: MIT.

This file is an overview for language models. The README is the user guide; AGENTS.md holds the rules for contributors.

## Key facts

- Domain `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station`; integration type `device`; IoT class `local_push`; Home Assistant 2026.10 or newer.
- Installed from the Home Assistant Marketplace as a custom repository: `https://github.com/webysther/ha-hikvision-virtual-indoor-station`.
- One config entry per door station, added with its address and an account of its web page. The door station's VoIP line must then point at Home Assistant (UDP port 5060), with its call button set to call the telephone gateway first.
- The device side lives in the library aiohikvision (PyPI, Apache-2.0, `https://github.com/webysther/aio-hikvision`), pinned to an exact version.
- Hybrid design: the call, the microphone during a call and the door's sound of an answered call go over SIP (G.711, 40 ms packets, the size the door station plays best; the card plays the door's sound with Web Audio, as Home Assistant's HLS keeps no G.711); the door's picture comes over RTSP (the camera entity, played with WebRTC), and its sound while monitoring; doors, the settings, the speaker outside a call and the health check go over ISAPI.
- Tested on a DS-KD8003-IME1(B) with firmware V3.7.3. Other DS-KD and DS-KV door stations with a VoIP line are expected to work.
- Texts in English, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. Self-assessed at the Platinum tier of the integration quality scale (`quality_scale.yaml`).

## Entities (per door station)

- Camera: RTSP stream with sound, and snapshots reshaped to the stream's aspect ratio.
- Doorbell (event): `ring`, `answered`, `rejected`, `missed`, `ended`, with `call_id`, `caller`, `callee`, `end_reason`.
- Call (sensor): `idle`, `ringing`, `answered`.
- SIP registration (diagnostic binary sensor): on while the door station can call Home Assistant.
- Buttons: one Open door per door (unavailable when its output drives no lock), Answer, Hang up, Reject.
- Output (diagnostic sensor): what a changeable output drives (`electric_lock`, `doorbell`, `disabled`).
- Input (diagnostic sensor): what a changeable input is wired for (`door_contact`, `exit_button`, `disabled`).
- CPU usage and Video sessions (diagnostic sensors): how loaded the door station is.
- Visits and Missed visits (sensors, `total_increasing`): counters of the rings, once each call is over; their long-term statistics give the visits of each day, week or month. The last 8 weeks of visits (time and outcome only) are kept in Home Assistant's storage and forgotten when the entry is removed.
- Visits by hour and Visits by day (images, SVG without words): a 24-hour clock of when the door rings over the last 8 weeks, and the visits of each of the last 28 days; green answered, amber missed, red refused.
- Settings (configuration numbers, selects and switches), as the door station offers them, read every 5 minutes: microphone, speaker and call volume; door open time (one per door); voice prompt when a door opens, and which; the camera image (day/night mode, brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, WDR; day/night sensitivity, WDR level, backlight compensation and its area, power line frequency disabled by default).

## Card, dashboard and panel

- Card `custom:hikvision-indoor-station-card`, keys `device_id`, `talk_mode` (`hold` or `toggle`), `shortcuts` (entities, or `{entity, name, icon}`), `show_name` (false: icons only), `show_state` (false: no name and call state over the camera), `show_monitor`, `show_talk`, `show_ringer` (false: that key hidden), `columns` (keys per row, 1 to 12), `rows` (rows of keys, 1 to 4; `columns` wins). A standard card laid out like an indoor station: the camera, then one row of keys (Answer, Hang up or Reject, Monitor, Push to talk, the ringer) with a key per door that opens and the shortcuts on its right.
- Dashboard strategy `custom:hikvision-indoor-station`: one view per door station, with its card, its activity, and its visits (the two charts and a weekly statistics graph of the counters over a quarter).
- Panel `/hikvision-indoor-station?entry=<entry_id>&call=<token>&answer=1`, out of the sidebar: a door station's card on its own page, opened by the phones' notifications.

## Mobile apps

- Each phone or tablet with the Home Assistant app (Mobile App) is a subentry `extension` of a door station: `device_id`, `do_not_disturb`, `open_door`. Adding or changing one does not reload the entry.
- When the door rings, each phone not in do not disturb gets a notification through `notify.mobile_app_<phone>`: the door's picture, time-sensitive on iOS, high priority on Android, buttons Answer (opens the panel, which answers), Open door (first door with a lock) and Reject. The buttons act only while their call lasts; the notification is cleared when the call moves on.
- Outside Home Assistant a call is named by a token (a SHA-256 digest of its SIP Call-ID, 16 hex digits), never by the Call-ID.
- A phone that leaves Home Assistant gets the repair issue `phone_gone`, whose fix removes it.

## Websocket commands (for cards)

- `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station/subscribe` `{entry_id}`: the state of the door station (registration, doors, locks, speaker, the latest call), pushed on every change.
- `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station/call` `{entry_id, call_id, action}`, with `action` one of `answer`, `reject`, `hangup`.
- `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station/open_door` `{entry_id, door}`.
- `hikvision_virtual_indoor_station/talk` `{entry_id}`: binary G.711 frames go to the answered call, or to the door's speaker outside a call.

## Known limits

- One SIP server on UDP port 5060: it cannot run next to another SIP server on that port (such as the Voice over IP integration).
- G.711 only. The door station's talk time ends calls (90 s by default). Half duplex: talk by turns.
- Talking needs Home Assistant opened over HTTPS (the browser's microphone).
- Android notifications show three buttons, so a notification opens the first door with a lock only.
